text_block_list.text:
The day of Yukino Bijin's scrimmage
arrives.

After watching over her training with
Sakura
Bakushin O, I can't help but feel
curious about
how the race will pan out,
so I drop by to watch.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, howdy-do!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the right headspace thanks to you
'n
Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All you've gotta do now is race and win!
Good
luck, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You got it!
choice_data_list: Let's show them what you've got!
Let's show them the results of our special training!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I was talk'n to the folks from my
hometown, and
they've all got high
hopes for me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So there's no way I'm losing!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get first place and show 'em
how
amaz'n I've become!

Yukino Bijin heads off with a confident
stride. The
look on her face is a far cry
from the one she had
before her intense
training.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All righty! I'm gonna use every trick
Bakushin O
taught me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're an Umamusume who's been
trained by the
class representative
herself! First place is yours
for the
taking!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much. I'm gonna run my heart
out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Go for it! Your instructor will be
watching
attentively from the stands!

We part ways with Yukino Bijin, and I
wait for the
race to start alongside
Sakura Bakushin O, who
has embraced
the role of instructor.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Yukino. I saw a banner with your
name on it
just now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, from my hometown support'rs! They
came all
the way here to cheer me on.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Really? Well...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
My desire to make the folks back home
happy is
just as strong as yours. I won't
lose today.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Oguri wants to win just as much as I
do... But...)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yukinooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Yukino Bijiiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-you guys!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's me, Yukino Bijin! I'm gonna show
everyone
the kinda guts the snowy
lands'll give ya!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I really wanna get first place! I wanna
run a great
race and hear them call me a
city girl!)

With the racers' entrances over, the race
is finally
about to begin.

The odds are in Oguri Cap's favor for
this race,
but an unexpected
Umamusume pulls out to the
front from
the get-go...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When push comes to shove, I get things
done! I'm
not gonna lose to Oguri or
anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'll show ever'one my Morioka spirit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoooooa! Yukino's pulling further and
further
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heh. That crazed energy is totally class
rep
worthy!

If she keeps that up, she's got this... I
watch with
bated breath as the race
unfolds...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Okay... I've got you now, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
N-not on my watch! You're not tak'n first
place
from me!

Oguri Cap pulls off a miraculous chase
and
gradually closes the gap with
Yukino Bijin. Yukino
Bijin battens down
and speeds up, buuut...

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
It's Oguri! She came from behind and
won it all!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text: That other girl... Yukino, was it? She did a great job, but ended up in second. Man, Oguri sure is fast.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aww... I failed... I wanted to show 'em
how cool I
could be...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You didn't fail. Listen. Can't you hear
them
cheering?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Congrats on second place, Yukino!
You're
Morioka's pride and joy!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You've become so fast and magnificent!
You're a
true city girl now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Everyone!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The cheers keep on com'n... like a
never-end'n
supply of wanko soba.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I did it... I gave my hometown a
performance to
be proud of...)

She may have ended up in second place,
but it's
clear that today's race has made
Yukino Bijin
stronger in both mind and
body.
